Criterion: Verify that support equipment does not adversely affect the safety of the air vehicle system. Standard: The support equipment used to perform maintenance functions on the air vehicle system is safe to operate and cannot adversely affect the safety of the air vehicle system. Method of Compliance: The safety of the support equipment is verified by review of the System Safety Hazard Analysis and through individual testing of the support equipment and compatibility testing with the air vehicle system. References: JSSG-2000: 3.6.1, 3.6.2 JSSG-2001: 3.1.5 14 CFR 23.1501, 23.1529, 25.1501, 25.1503-25.1533, 25.1529, 25.1541, 25.1543, 25.1557, 25.1563

Standard: Maintenance publications identify support equipment used to perform maintenance functions on the air vehicle. The support equipment used during maintenance will not introduce AW hazards. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine the maintenance publications to verify that air vehicle specific operating parameters and procedures used with support equipment are included.
(2) Examine the artifacts that demonstrate contractor certification or contractor validation to ensure the maintenance publications have undergone a quality check for currency and accuracy IAW TO 00-5-3, Contractor Certification Process and Certification Requirements paragraphs for the Air Force; NAVAIR 00-25-604, Contractor Validation Plan and Validation paragraphs for the Navy; and DA PAM 25-40, Validation paragraphs for the Army. Demonstration.
  (1) Perform air vehicle maintainability demonstrations to confirm maintenance publication procedures associated with support equipment are complete, accurate, can be performed as written, and the use of support equipment does not introduce AW hazards. Maintenance publications will receive updates to address maintenance issues discovered during maintainability demonstrations. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
  (2) Perform all air vehicle maintenance procedures that require support equipment on production-configured hardware using government maintenance personnel to ensure maintenance procedures using support equipment do not introduce AW hazards.
